# Discovered files

<!-- generated by `python -m quality.sdk --reference`; edit the source, never this -->

Registration is by discovery: drop the file with the conventional name, and its reader finds it.

| File | What it declares | Read by |
|---|---|---|
| `apps.py` | the app itself and its `depends_on`; `INSTALLED_APPS` is derived from it; a link to another app's noun: [A link between two apps](linking-apps.md) | `config/settings/discovery.py:133` |
| `api.py` | `router` — mounted under `/api/v1/<PREFIX or label>/` | `config/api.py:284` |
| `api.py` | `TAGS` — the scope families a token's ceiling names | `apps/core/api/scopes.py:164` |
| `mcp.py` | `register(server)` — the app's MCP tools | `config/mcp.py:97` |
| `consumers.py` | `websocket_urlpatterns` — under `token_auth(...)` | `config/asgi.py:41` |
| `workflows.py` | `WORKFLOWS` — registered on the worker | `apps/workflows/client.py:130` |
| `activities.py` | `ACTIVITIES` and `SCHEDULES` | `apps/workflows/client.py:156` |
| `events.py` | the app's event names (upper-case string constants) | `apps/events/events.py:24` |
| `policies.py` | `POLICIES`, `ACTION_PROSE`, `DEFAULT_ROLES`, `RENAMED_PERMISSIONS` | `apps/core/authz.py:311` |
| `roles.py` | `ROLES` | `apps/core/authz.py:1033` |
| `surfaces.py` | `SURFACES` | `apps/core/surfaces.py:68` |
| `search.py` | `SEARCHABLES` | `apps/search/registry.py:73` |
| `meters.py` | the app's usage meters; what it holds: [Metering usage from a verb](metering-usage.md) | `apps/usage/meters.py:38` |
| `lifecycle.py` | `register(registry)` — third-party tables only | `apps/core/lifecycle.py:139` |
| `integrations.py` | inbound webhook handlers, run in a workflow per receipt (never `webhooks.py` — rule 11) | `apps/core/integrations.py:100` |
| `archive_blockers.py · restore_blockers.py · move_blockers.py · merge_blockers.py` | `BLOCKERS` | `apps/core/verbs.py:72` |
| `merge_repointers.py` | `REPOINTERS` | `apps/core/verbs.py:76` |
| `importers.py` | `IMPORTERS` | `apps/core/verbs.py:77` |
| `services.py` | every `@service` — the doors' census | `apps/core/discovery.py:142` |

Not discovered: `schemas.py`, `selectors.py`, `types.py`, `models.py` — your own doors and
services import them; Django reads `models.py` and `migrations/` for an installed app.
The walk itself is `apps/core/discovery.py` (`roads discover`); nothing under `config/` is
edited to register anything.
